title: How Passkeys Work: The Login You Cannot Type Into a Fake Site
description:
How a passkey login works: public and private keys, signed challenges, website identity, local verification, synced storage, and recovery. Conceptual diagrams, no real credentials or biometric data. Phishing resistance is not a promise that the whole account is invulnerable.

0:00 A login without a reusable password
1:02 Two keys, different jobs
2:13 Why the website identity matters
3:24 Your face is a local unlock
4:31 Synced does not mean device-bound
5:43 The rest of the account still matters
